test_title: PYST 1: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words

Geeta is doubtful about getting hired as she is __inexperienced at this job__.
solution: The correct answer is **'Novice'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Novice**__**: A person who is new and without experience in a certain job (किसी विशेष काम के लिए नया और अनुभवहीन व्यक्ति)** __ • **E.g.**__- I’m just a **novice** at making videos. Hence, the correct answer is **'Novice'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Professional**__**: Doing something in a way that shows skill, training or care (निपुणता, प्रशिक्षण या सावधानी के साथ कुछ करते हुए)** __ • **E.g.**__- The police are trained to deal with every situation in a calm and **professional** manner. • __**Expert**__ **: A person who has a lot of special knowledge or skill (विषय का विशेषज्ञ)** __ • **​E.g.__**- She’s a leading **expert** in the field of genetics. • ​__**Ace**__**: A** **person who is very skilled at something (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी चीज में बहुत कुशल हो****)** __ • **​E.g.__**- They were the one who could prove to me that I wasn’t **ace**. 3a:T6d8, The correct answer is **'DACB'.**
